title.zh: 超级玛丽 3D 重制版：第一关

series: 万物皆可游戏 · Everything Can Be a Game
source: FC Super Mario Bros. World 1-1 (Nintendo, 1985) — fan-made procedural remake, not an official release
engine: Three.js 0.170.0 (vendored at public/vendor/three/0.170.0), zero build step

controls.keyboard: A/D run, W/S depth lane, K/W/Space jump (hold = higher), J run fast, Q/E orbit, R/F tilt, C recenter, Esc pause
controls.mobile: Left virtual stick, J run / K jump buttons, camera pad, landscape required (rotated-layout fallback)

rules: Small Mario dies on enemy contact / pit / timeout; mushroom makes him big (one free hit); stomp enemies; 100 coins = 1-UP; flagpole ends the stage with height + time bonus
license: Code MIT as part of the repo; Nintendo trademarks/artwork belong to Nintendo. Original procedural art & sound.
